description: If two pairs of subsets agree modulo an ideal, their intersections and unions agree modulo the ideal, and the corresponding complements agree as well.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.eqMod_operations_compatible.{u} {α : Type u} (I : Order.Ideal (Set α))
  (A A' B B' : Set α) (hA : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.EqMod I A A')
  (hB : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.EqMod I B B') :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.EqMod I (A ∩ B) (A' ∩ B') ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.EqMod I (A ∪ B) (A' ∪ B') ∧
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.EqMod I Aᶜ A'ᶜ
